prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
engine_stated_criteria: Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential
Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self
answer_verbatim:
The **best online courses** in your results are the ones with the clearest Jungian or structured shadow-work focus, plus explicit practices you can apply consistently. For a more **spiritual-practice-oriented** approach, the strongest match is the course that explicitly includes meditations, prayers, and practices for “spiritual transformation.”[8][14]

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | **Jungian shadow work** | Described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[5][12] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** (Udemy) | **Shadow work + spiritual practice** | Includes lessons, exercises, diagrams, inspirational quotes, meditations, prayers, and practices for introspective shadow work and spiritual transformation.[8] |
| **Inner Healing Shadow Work Course** (Rediscovering Sacredness) | **Most comprehensive** | Described as the most comprehensive online video course on shadow work and framed as exploring unconscious patterns and limiting beliefs in a supportive environment.[18] |
| **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** (Centre of Excellence) | **Reflective self-understanding** | Presented as a deeply reflective journey of self-understanding inspired by Jungian psychology and modern personal development.[3] |
| **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** (ManTalks) | **Guided process** | Offers an immersive 8-week guided process for fully facing and integrating the shadow.[17] |

If your goal is **serious shadow work with a psychological foundation**, start with **Encounters with the Shadow**.[5][12] If you want a course that blends **shadow work with spirituality**, **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** is the clearest fit from the results because it explicitly includes **meditations, prayers, and spiritual transformation** language.[8]

A few other options in your results are more generic or marketing-heavy, but still potentially useful:
- **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** on Udemy, which emphasizes healing, hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[2]
- **Embracing the Shadow: A Journey to Healing and Wholeness**, which focuses on uncovering and integrating hidden parts of yourself.[4]
- **Shadow Work Essentials**, which centers on techniques to uncover and heal parts that have been shamed or exiled into the subconscious.[13]

- **best for spiritual practice**
- **best for Jungian psychology**
